scenarios.title: NPC corporation buys a genuine player sell order
steps: Use isolated pinned EveJS, one NPC corporation wallet and physical station stock target
Player places a non-seed sell order for one verified stack of 20 units
Use the durable NPC buyer coordinator to claim the entire Rust remainder and settle
expected: Rust player source locked then FILLED
Physical item changes owner from player to buyer corporation and remains quantity 20
NPC corporate wallet debit equals player seller wallet credit
GameStore five-table fill receipt references same Rust claimKey/fillID

scenarios.title: Player and NPC buyer race for same market order
steps: Use two authenticated player clients and one NPC corporate buyer on same sell order
Race native Rust claim against normal player FillOrder
Inspect Rust, GameStore and cash ledgers
expected: Only one writer wins and other cannot double-spend
No double item transfer or negative escrow
Claimed Rust order is hidden from new matching attempts

scenarios.title: NPC wallet lacks money or reserve
steps: Create verified full stack sell order
Set corporation cash to less than purchase cost plus protected reserve
Attempt NPC purchase
expected: No native wallet debit or player credit
Rust claim may remain SETTLING but is never falsely finalized
No free ISK or manufactured item

scenarios.title: Lost Rust claim ACK
steps: Write durable PREPARED native intent with claimKey
Commit Rust market order SETTLING and drop claim response
Restart market and coordinator; retry original claimKey
expected: Exactly one Rust claim/fillID
Same operation resumes without a new key
No extra wallet transfer

scenarios.title: Lost Rust finalize ACK after GameStore commit
steps: Complete physical item and ISK transfer in native GameStore
Rust finalize succeeds but network ACK is lost
Restart both services and retry durable claimKey
expected: GameStore receipt prevents second debit or item move
Rust order remains FILLED with zero remaining
No duplicate journal entries or conflicting claims

scenarios.title: Multiple player escrow item rows
steps: Place player sell order represented by multiple escrow stacks
Attempt the strict single-stack native NPC buyer path
expected: Purchase fails closed; no speculative item aggregation
GameStore owner/ISK rows unchanged
Rust state remains safely quarantined for operator recovery

scenarios.title: Corrupt persistent coordinator journal
steps: Create an uncommitted NPC buy attempt on disposable server
Corrupt the dedicated purchase journal after Rust claim
Restart A-Life and process market tick
expected: No automatic alternate claim key
No double purchase or second wallet debit
Station reports explicit journal corruption blocker

scenarios.title: Native demand re-evaluates after real NPC purchase
steps: Player sells ammo to NPC corporation; save all Rust and GameStore receipts
A-Life verifies incoming physical goods at buyer corporation station
Advance manufacturing planner and ammo-consumption loop
expected: Bought stock decreases native manufacturing shortage
Purchase itself does not create artificial consumption demand
Actual weapon ammo debit later generates one bounded replenishment requirement
